findings.issue: son is a supplied copula in a verbless clause and is not marked with asterisks
The 3mp suffix can refer to the waters or the sons; after feminine Ellas/aguas, en ellos selects the sons
3mp pronoun is rendered feminine to agree with Spanish aguas; the referent stays the waters
The token is only a relative; donde selects a locative reading

notes: Other tokens match number, person, qal 3cp, niphal 3ms, con, and Jehová.
